messages:
Sandra: Hey team — want to lock down a concrete plan for the joint perf/W + throughput run with NVIDIA and AWS. Goal is a public-friendly benchmark (perf/W numbers + sustained throughput) and internal kernel tuning notes we can share with partners.
Kevin: +1. high-level ask: 1) power-normalized numbers (Watt draw + tokens/sec), 2) steadystate throughput for 2k/8k/16k seq, 3) kernel patch impact (latency and perf/W).
Matt: Suggest matrix: models = [Llama-2-13B, Falcon-40B], quant = [fp16, int8], batch = [1, 8, 32], seq = [2k, 8k, 16k]. We should include cold vs warm KV-cache numbers.
Sandra: Agreed. Can NVIDIA confirm preferred HW to highlight? (we'd like H100S + A800 comparison if available). Also need list of driver/OS/kernel versions to reproduce.
NVIDIA Eng: H100S + A800 are fine. Recommend driver 535.54+, CUDA 12.2. We'll provide recommended kernel params (hugepages + iommu tweaks) and a diff for the fused-kernel branch. We'll also share perf counters for power (NVML) and PCIe metrics.
Anya: For public write-up, marketing wants a short narrative: "up to X tokens/sec at Y W" and a caveat about synthetic workloads vs app-level. We'll need partner signoff on numbers. Timeline?
Sandra: Proposed timeline: week 1 = integration + infra setup, week 2 = runs + kernel tuning, week 3 = validation + write-up. Can partners commit to kernel diff review by EOD Thu?
NVIDIA Eng: We can review diffs by Thu EOD. We need the exact bench script and environment variables you plan to run.
Kevin: Here's a minimal run script snippet we use in CI, adapt as needed:
```bash
# run_bench.sh (simplified)
MODEL=$1
SEQ=$2
BATCH=$3
QUANT=$4
./redwood_bench --model $MODEL --seq-length $SEQ --batch-size $BATCH --quant $QUANT --measure-power --num-steps 500
```
Matt: We'll add kv-cache warmup: prefill 50 steps before measuring and capture NVML power samples at 1s. Also capture TSC-based latency percentiles.
NVIDIA Eng: For kernel tuning, try these knobs: nr_hugepages=1024, iommu=pt, and enable movdqa optimizations in fused kernel. We'll test patch on our infra and report delta.
Sandra: Who owns the marketplace/announcement coordination with AWS? Need someone to loop in legal for co-branded assets + badge.
AWS BD: I can own marketplace/announcement coordination. For co-branding we need a 2-week legal review once numbers are finalized. Keep the public claim conservative.
Anya: I'll draft the blog skeleton and assets checklist. Can we aim to freeze numbers by next Friday so legal has 2 weeks?
Kevin: Dependencies: infra queues, power meters hooked to hosts (we use ipmi+NVML), kernel patch checkout, and a reproducible AMI/container. I'll provision infra this afternoon.
Benchmark Bot: Scheduled run created: bench-run-1755019999 on infra-pool-3, estimated runtime 6h. Status: queued. :gear:
Sandra: Nice. Action items: @NVIDIA Eng -> kernel diff by Thu, @Kevin -> infra + AMI today, @Matt -> bench scripts + KV warmup by tomorrow, @AWS BD -> marketplace/legal kickoff. We'll sync Fri 10am PT.
Matt: I'll upload scripts to the shared repo and add README with reproduction steps. Expect PR by tomorrow noon.
NVIDIA Eng: One more ask — can you include a lightweight e2e app test (real chat load) to complement synthetic token loops? It helps contextualize perf/W.
Sandra: Good point. Add that to the matrix as an "app-sim" run at batch sizes 8 and 32.
Anya: I'll note that in the blog draft. Thanks all, moving this to a single doc after lunch. :memo:
